name: deep-research-template
purpose: Template input for complete-deep-research. It validates whether a deep research package is ready for long-form report writing.

reader_guide.summary: Copy this file when a task needs a detailed source-grounded report. Fill the research package fields, then run complete-deep-research before writing or publishing the report.
how_to_read: Read research_question and report_goal to understand the report task.
Check research_profile_paths to see which research rules shaped the package.
Check deep_research_stages and research_iterations to confirm the work was not single-pass search.
Check evidence_items, citation_audit_notes, and unsupported_or_weak_claims before trusting the report.
Check report_targets to find where the final report should be saved.
update_triggers: complete-deep-research adds or removes input fields.
deep-research-profile thresholds or required stages change.
A real deep research report exposes missing fields in this template.

structure_rules.rule: This template should remain a valid sample that returns ready_to_write_report.
structure_rules.reason: The template doubles as documentation and a CLI smoke test.

structure_rules.rule: Evidence items should use a claim <- source pattern.
structure_rules.reason: Future report writers and evaluators need to audit citation support quickly.

field_guide.meaning: The question the report should answer.
Research depth: standard, deep, or exhaustive.
Claim-to-source evidence items that will support the report.
Notes confirming whether citations support the claims they are attached to.
Where the final report should be written.

research_question: What should a deep research agent validate before writing a detailed source-grounded report?
report_goal: Prepare a detailed report that explains deep research agent requirements and cites checked sources.
trigger_situation: The user asks for deep multi-source research or a detailed report.
research_iterations: Iteration 1: searched official deep research product/API docs to identify report-generation stages.
Iteration 2: searched open-source implementations and papers to identify citation audit and evaluation risks.
source_quality_notes: Official vendor docs are used for workflow and tool capability framing.
Papers are used for citation-audit and faithfulness risk framing.
Open-source repositories are used for architecture pattern discovery, not as proof of product capability.
evidence_items: Deep research should handle complex analysis across many sources <- OpenAI API Deep Research docs.
Research tasks can decompose into planning, searching, and reasoning/synthesis <- Exa Research API docs.
Deep research can use todo planning and sub-agent research before cited report synthesis <- LangChain Deep Agents docs.
Open-source deep research can use supervisor-researcher and parallel processing patterns <- langchain-ai/open_deep_research.
Citations in deep research reports can be unreliable without verification <- Cited but Not Verified paper.
Report evaluation can extract citations and statements to check faithfulness <- ReportBench paper.
contradiction_notes: Vendor docs emphasize comprehensive reports, while evaluation papers emphasize that citations and report fluency do not guarantee factual faithfulness.
synthesis_notes: A deep research readiness agent should require iterative retrieval, source quality notes, evidence items, contradiction mapping, citation audit, and report targets.
citation_requirements: Every material factual claim in the final report must be traceable to a checked source.
Claims with weak, partial, stale, or conflicting support must be listed before publication.
citation_audit_notes: Evidence items use claim <- source format so a report writer can verify citation support before drafting.
The final report must run hallucination-guard-agent if it contains factual claims.
unsupported_or_weak_claims: No unresolved claim is accepted in this template; future reports must record explicit none-found audits or unresolved claims.
source_value_provenance: Deep research stage model <- checked OpenAI, Exa, LangChain docs on 2026-06-01.
Citation audit requirement <- checked Cited but Not Verified and ReportBench papers on 2026-06-01.
risks_or_unknowns: This template validates a research package but does not run retrieval itself.
Citation audit quality depends on actual source-content checking.
follow_up_questions: Should a future implementation integrate web search API, browser automation, file search, or MCP connectors?
